name: merge3

test_list.description: A wide diff hunk spanning adjacent declarations reports only the declaration edited differently by both sides, in either side order.
Edits to different functions merge into one exact result.
Different edits of the same function report that symbol as a conflict.
A conflict anywhere makes the whole outcome a Conflict; no merged bytes are produced.
CRLF inputs merge without introducing a bare LF, including separators for added functions.
A leading BOM survives the merge.
Two different new functions at the same spot are both kept, ours first.
Two different definitions of one new symbol conflict.
The same edit on both sides is applied once.
Delete vs edit conflicts; delete vs unrelated edit merges.
Different methods of one impl merge; the same method conflicts as Type::method.
New methods from both sides in one impl are both kept.
Python class methods merge independently, indentation preserved.
TypeScript exported functions merge independently.
C++ and CUDA functions merge independently.
Non-declaration top-level lines (imports) are merged by content.
Mixed languages return LanguageMismatch.
merge3(x, x, x) returns x in every language.
Property: when one side equals base the result is byte-identical to the other side.
Property: edits to different functions commute and equal the combined edit.

output_description: Merged(bytes) or Conflict { symbols }; never partial bytes on conflict.
